call_points.text: Scheduled FY27 capex of $70 million for SEAMEC ANANT acquisition.
Seamec Paladin remains stranded in Dubai; no revenue in April-May 2026.
Management expects stable margins despite higher EPC or O&M mix.
Plan to sell one bulk carrier (Pearl or Gallant) to focus on core DSV.
Seamec-II contracted until August 2026, then scheduled for dry dock.
Seamec Diamond charter rate is $8,750 per day with ONGC.
Management reported record annual revenue and profit in FY26 driven by fleet deployment and execution.
Seamec Agastya acquisition completed and vessel formally taken over in Singapore in August 2025.
Awarded O&M contract for ONGC MSVs Samudra Prabha and Samudra Sevak for 2026–2028.
Seamec Paladin dry dock completed in Dubai but vessel stranded due to West Asia conflict.
Withdrew from High-Speed Rail tunnel project in Vapi after completing 80%.

operating_notes.text: Vessel SEAMEC GLORIOUS charter with L&T extended to May 15, 2026, for ₹6.54 Cr.
Vessel SEAMEC SWORDFISH back on hire after technical defect redressal.
Executed contract with ONGC for O&M services of MSV Samudra Sevak for 2026-2028.
Vessel SAMUDRA PRABHA delivered to the company following HOTO completion for contract execution.
Vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS chartered to Lamprell Energy for 15 days at USD 2.12 million for ONGC offshore activities.
Vessel SAMUDRA PRABHA off-hired effective May 12, 2026 at 17:30 hrs due to operational reasons.
Charter of vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS with Lamprell Energy (USD 2.12 million) cancelled due to bad weather.
FY26 overseas segment result turned positive at ₹20.01 Cr vs ₹42.62 Cr loss in FY25.
Proposed RPT limit increase with HAL Offshore to USD 65 million p.a.
FY26 consolidated revenue reached ₹1,000 Cr, the highest ever.
Seamec Paladin remains stranded in Dubai yard awaiting safe navigation through Strait of Hormuz.
Withdrew from High-Speed Rail NATM tunnel project in Vapi at 80% completion.
Vessel SEAMEC DIAMOND off-hired due to technical reasons.
Barge SEAMEC GLORIOUS off-hired after completing charter with Larsen & Toubro Limited.
Vessel SEAMEC SWORDFISH off-hired due to technical breakdown.
Vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS completed 2nd season of PRP-VIII and DUDP.
Seamec Diamond charter rate with ONGC is $8,750 per day.
Consortium share for Supreme Hydro in O&M contracts is 10%.
Management plans to sell one bulk carrier (Pearl or Gallant) in FY27.
Vessel Seamec Diamond on-hired after resolving technical issue.
Barge SEAMEC GLORIOUS arrived at Pipava Yard for scheduled statutory drydocking at SWAN Defence and Heavy Industries Limited.
Vessel Samudra Prabha on-hired with ONGC with effect from May 30, 2026.
Vessel Samudra Prabha successfully on-hired with ONGC after DP and FiFi trials.

Vessel SEAMEC III successfully completed its second Part Replacement Pipeline Project, Pipeline Replacement Project – Group A (PRP-VIII A) and DSF II Project with G R Infraprojects Limited and off-hired.
Executed O&M contract with ONGC for MSV Samudra Prabha for 2026-2028 in consortium with Supreme Hydro Pvt Ltd.
Contract for charter hire of Vessel SEAMEC ANANT for about 1225 days for USD 55 million.

timeline.summary: Seamec extended the charter of vessel SEAMEC GLORIOUS with L&T until May 15, 2026, for ₹6.54 Cr.
Seamec vessel SEAMEC SWORDFISH returned to hire on April 24, 2026, following technical defect redressal.
Seamec executed a contract with ONGC for O&M services of the vessel Samudra Sevak for the 2026-2028 period.
Seamec took delivery of the vessel SAMUDRA PRABHA on May 8, 2026, following the completion of handover procedures.
Seamec entered into a 15-day charter party with Lamprell Energy Limited for the vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS valued at USD 2.12 million.
Seamec's vessel SAMUDRA PRABHA went off-hire effective May 12, 2026 due to operational reasons.
Seamec's charter of vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS with Lamprell Energy was cancelled due to bad weather.
Seamec reported record FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,000 Cr and a 188% surge in net profit.
Seamec vessel SEAMEC DIAMOND went off-hire on May 21, 2026, due to technical reasons.
Barge 'SEAMEC GLORIOUS' was off-hired on May 22, 2026, after completing its charter with Larsen & Toubro.
Vessel SEAMEC SWORDFISH went off-hire on May 22, 2026, due to a technical breakdown.
Vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS completed the second season of the PRP VIII and DUDP projects on May 26, 2026.
Seamec reported record FY26 results and guided for 15% growth in FY27 while managing geopolitical disruptions in Dubai.
Seamec Limited’s officials will hold an Investor/Analyst Roadshow on June 4–5, 2026, 11:00 AM–6:00 PM IST, discussing publicly available information.
On May 27, 2026, Seamec announced that Vessel Seamec Diamond was on-hired following the resolution of technical issues.
On May 29, 2026, Seamec Limited announced that barge SEAMEC GLORIOUS arrived at Pipava Yard for scheduled statutory drydocking.
On May 30, 2026, Seamec announced that vessel Samudra Prabha was on-hired with ONGC starting May 30, 2026.
On May 31, 2026, Seamec announced the successful on-hire deployment of vessel Samudra Prabha with ONGC following DP and FiFi trials.
On May 31, 2026, Seamec announced that Vessel SEAMEC III successfully completed pipeline replacement and DSF II projects with G R Infraprojects and off-hired ahead of scheduled drydocking.
On June 1, 2026, Seamec announced the execution of the O&M contract with ONGC for MSV Samudra Prabha for 2026-2028.
Seamec reported CRISIL reaffirmation of its CRISIL A+/Stable long-term and CRISIL A1 short-term ratings on enhanced bank facilities of ₹883 Cr.
Seamec Limited took over vessel 'SEAMEC ANANT' from HAL Offshore Limited on 14th October 2026.
Seamec entered into a ₹464.2 Cr contract with HAL Offshore on October 21, 2026, for charter hire of vessel SEAMEC ANANT.
